```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(mar)
library(terra)
```

```{r core commands}
# genomaps object: genotypes (10,000 biallelic SNPs) and coordinates of 1004 A. thaliana samples
data(gm1001g)
# site-frequency spectrum: number of sites with k = 0, 1, 2, ... mutated chromosomes
obssfs <- sfs(gm1001g)
# theoretical MAR predicted from the SFS, assuming random mating and random spatial distribution
theorydf <- MARtheory(gm1001g)
# empirical MAR: genetic diversity and area in replicated square subsamples of increasing size
mardf <- MARsampling(gm1001g, myseed = 91)
# extinction simulation: iteratively remove raster cells and track the remaining genetic diversity
extdf <- MARextinction(gm1001g, myseed = 91)
# fit the power-law model M = cA^z to estimate the scaling factor z
marfit <- MARcalc(mardf)
```

```{r results}
# extract resolution of the reference raster map (determined automatically, Hengl 2006)
# samplemap is stored wrapped, unwrap it with terra::unwrap() before use (see ?marmaps)
sm <- terra::unwrap(gm1001g$maps$samplemap)
sm

# number of raster cells occupied, and number of samples per cell
cellinfo <- as.vector(table(gm1001g$maps$cellid))
length(cellinfo)
summary(cellinfo)
```

```{r mar}
# summary of the sars power-law fit (S == c * A^z; S here is the number of mutations M):
#   Parameters: c (intercept) and z (scaling factor, the rate of genetic diversity loss),
#     with standard error, t-test p-value Pr(>|t|), and 95% confidence interval (2.5%, 97.5%)
#   R2 / R2a: (adjusted) proportion of variation in M explained by area
#   AIC/AICc/BIC compare models fitted to the same data only
marfitsum <- summary(marfit)
marfitsum
# z and 95% confidence interval, using occupied grid cell areas (A)
round(marfitsum$Parameters['z',c('Estimate', '2.5%', '97.5%')], digits = 2)
# p-value of z
round(marfitsum$Parameters['z', 'Pr(>|t|)'], digits = 3)
# adjusted R2
round(marfitsum$R2a, digits = 2)
```

```{r marasq}
# refit using the total square area (Asq) regardless of individual occupancy:
# accounts for variation in sample size across space, but weakens the correlation
marfit_asq <- MARcalc(mardf, Atype = 'Asq')
marfitsum <- summary(marfit_asq)
round(marfitsum$Parameters['z',c('Estimate', '2.5%', '97.5%')], digits = 2)
round(marfitsum$Parameters['z', 'Pr(>|t|)'], digits = 3)
round(marfitsum$R2a, digits = 2)
```

```{r extpred}
# genetic diversity loss prediction: 1 - m = (1 - a)^z
a = 0.38  # proportion of area lost (38% global terrestrial area transformed, Millennium Ecosystem Assessment)
z = 0.46  # scaling factor inferred from MARsampling (M ~ A)
# proportion of genetic diversity (number of mutations) remaining, ~80%
# note: this estimates short-term loss; genetic drift will continue eroding diversity over time
m_remaining = (1-a)^z
m_remaining
```

```{r marother}
# genetic-diversity-area relationship (GDAR) for additional genetic diversity metrics:
#   E: endemic mutations, only existing in the sampled region
#   thetaw: Watterson's theta, number of segregating sites with a sample size scaling factor
#   thetapi: nucleotide diversity, average pairwise differences between samples (less sensitive to rare alleles)
# extract z (95% CI), p-value of z, and adjusted R2 from each sars fit
extract_summary <- function(x) {
    sumx <- summary(x)
    a = round(sumx$Parameters['z',c('Estimate', '2.5%', '97.5%')], digits = 2)
    b = round(sumx$Parameters['z', 'Pr(>|t|)'], digits = 3)
    c = round(sumx$R2a, digits = 2)
    out <- c(a,b,c)
    return(out)
}
Mtypes = c('E', 'thetaw', 'thetapi')
marfit_list <- lapply(Mtypes, MARcalc, mardf = mardf)
# higher z: diversity saturates slower with area, and is lost faster with area loss
summarydf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(marfit_list, extract_summary))
dimnames(summarydf)[[1]] <- Mtypes
dimnames(summarydf)[[2]][4:5] <- c('Pr(>|t|)', 'R2_adj')
print(summarydf)
```

```{r Fig2, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, fig.cap = "Sample map (A), observed site-frequency spectrum (B), MAR sampling curve (C), and extinction curve (D) for the global Arabidopsis 1001G dataset."}
par(mfrow = c(2,2), mar = c(4,4,3,2))
plot(gm1001g$maps, xlab = "Easting (EPSG:8857)", ylab = "Northing", pax = list(cex.lab = 1))
mtext("A", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
plot(obssfs, expected = gm1001g, log = 'x')
mtext("B", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
plot(mardf, fit = marfit$par)
mtext("C", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
plot(extdf, fit = marfit$par)
mtext("D", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
```

```{r FigS1, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "MAR sampling curve fit using area in number of samples (Atype = 'N'), with the theoretical expectation overlaid."}
plot(mardf, fit = TRUE, Atype = 'N', theory = theorydf)
```

```{r FigS2, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "MAR sampling curve fit using squared area (Atype = 'Asq')."}
plot(mardf, fit = TRUE, Atype = 'Asq')
```

```{r FigS3, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 12, fig.cap = "MAR sampling curves fit to the number of segregating sites (E), Watterson's theta (thetaw), and nucleotide diversity (thetapi)."}
Mtypes = c('E', 'thetaw', 'thetapi')
panel_labels <- c('A', 'B', 'C')
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
for (i in seq_along(Mtypes)) {
    plot(mardf, fit = TRUE, Mtype = Mtypes[i])
    mtext(panel_labels[i], side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
}
```

```{r FigS4, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Extinction curve with the power-law relationship predicted from the MAR fit (red line) overlaid."}
plot(extdf, fit = TRUE)
curve((1 - x)^marfit$par['z'], add = TRUE, col = 'red')
```
